title: Jayco, Inc.: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:TAIL LIGHTS (36,082 affected)
summary: THE STOP LAMPS ON THESE TRAILERS FAILED TO COMPLY WITH PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108.

title: ROVER GROUP, LIMITED: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:METALLIC (2,271 affected)
summary: THE RIGHT REAR METAL BRAKE LINE COULD COME IN CONTACT WITH THE TOP OF THE RIGHT REAR SHOCK ABSORBER. THIS COULD LEAD TO AN EVENTUAL FLUID LEAK IN ONE OF THE TWO BRAKE CIRCUITS.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (3,673 affected)
summary: STRESSES IMPOSED ON THE LEVER DURING TURNING MANEUVERS AND/OR IMPACT INCIDENTS, SUCH AS WOULD BE CAUSED BY CURBS OR ROAD SURFACE IRREGULARITY, REDUCE THE LIFE EXPECTANCY OF THE PART. THE STEERING LEVER MAY CRACK AND EVENTUALLY THE STRESSES COULD CAUSE THE STEERING LEVER TO BREAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:CAM:FAST IDLE (1,400 affected)
summary: THE THROTTLE CABLE WHICH RUNS FROM THE ACCELERATOR TO THE GOVERNOR ASSEMBLY HOUSING MAY HAVE BEEN KINKED DURING ASSEMBLY, CAUSING EXCESSIVE WEAR OF THE CABLE HOUSING INNER LINING. THIS COULD RESULT IN EITHER FRACTURE OR STICKING OF THE CABLE.

title: EXPLORER MOTOR HOME CORP.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (22,037 affected)
summary: THE REAR SEAT SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE FAILED TO SUSTAIN THE LOADS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 210. SAFETY BELTS ARE ANCHORED TO A BAR ATTACHED TO THE FLOOR OF THE VEHICLE.

title: Utilimaster Corporation: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (541 affected)
summary: THE PRIMARY HOOD LATCH CAN RELEASE WHEN VEHICLE IS DRIVEN IN THE CONDITION OF HIGH WIND GUSTS. THE PRIMARY HOOD LATCH FAILURE WILL ALSO CAUSE THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH TO FAIL SIMULTANEOUSLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:FRONT BUCKET SEAT LATCH (173 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SEAT UPPER HINGE COVER SCREWS ARE TOO LONG, AND INTERFERE WITH THE SEAT BACK INERTIA LOCK. THIS PREVENTS THE SEAT BACK FROM LOCKING PROPERLY.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (485 affected)
summary: SAFETY BELTS ARE DESIGNED TO BE ROUTED UNDER A DIAGONAL CROSS BRACE DURING FASTENING. THE INSTRUCTIONAL LABELS FOR THE BELT ROUTING ARE INADEQUATE, AND CAN RESULT IN INADVERTENT RELEASE OF THE BELT BUCKLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR (125,000 affected)
summary: THE NUTS WHICH HOLD WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR TO THE WIPER MODULE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SUFFICIENTLY TIGHTENED AND MAY LOOSEN OR COME OFF. THIS CAUSES CHANGED WIPER PATTERNS, OR THE WIPERS MAY JAM IF TWO OF THE THREE NUTS COME OFF.

title: COSCO, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (9,519 affected)
summary: THE CHILD SEATS FAIL TO MEET THE HEAD EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213 (EXCEEDED PRESCRIBED 32 INCH HEAD EXCURSION LIMIT).

title: GANEAUX INDUSTRIES: EQUIPMENT:JACKS:STAND (1,350,000 affected)
summary: SADDLE ON THE CENTER COLUMN OF THE JACK STAND ALLOWS OFF-CENTER LOADING, AND THE BASE AND INNER TUBE ASSEMBLY MATERIALS ARE OF INSUFFICIENT STRENGTH TO WITHSTAND PIN-HOLE DISTORTION UNDER LOAD.

title: Mazda North American Operations: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:ANTI-SKID SYSTEM (300 affected)
summary: A RETURN FLUID LINE OF THE FRONT BRAKE SYSTEM IS MISCONNECTED TO A REAR BRAKE FLUID RETURN. WHEN THE ABS SYSTEM COMES INTO USE, ALL THE FLUID FROM THE FRONT BRAKES GOES TO THE REAR BRAKE SYSTEM. THE FLUID RETURNS TO THE FRONT SYSTEM WHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS RELEASED.

title: AUSTIN ROVER CARS NA, INC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (4,028 affected)
summary: AUTOMATIC SHOULDER BELT ASSEMBLY MAY MALFUNCTION DURING ABRUPT BRAKING OR CORNERING. THE ASSEMBLY MAY TIGHTEN AGAINST THE OCCUPANT  RESTRICTING MOVEMENT. ALSO, THE RETRACTOR DRIVER UNIT MAY STALL IN ANY POSITION, LEAVING THE BELT LOOSE. IN EITHER CASE, THE BELT WOULD NOT RETRACT WHEN THE DOOR IS OPENED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:LINKAGES AND CA (90 affected)
summary: MISMATCHED PARKING BRAKE CABLE LENGTHS TO THE REAR WHEELS REDUCES BRAKING ABILITY OF ONE OF THE REAR WHEELS, IN VIOLATION OF FMVSS 105.

title: PETERSON AUTOMOTIVE CORP.: EQUIPMENT:JACKS:STAND (333,130 affected)
summary: JACK STAND CANNOT HOLD THE RATED CAPACITY OF 8,000 POUNDS ON A SINGLE POST OF THE SADDLE.

title: Aston Martin The Americas: HEATER:COMBUSTION(GAS):DEFROSTER:DEFOGGER (1,105 affected)
summary: INTERNAL STRESSES OF THE HEATER MAY CAUSE THE COVER TO THE HEATER UNIT FUEL PUMP TO LOOSEN, RESULTING IN A FUEL LEAK.

title: FISHER-PRICE, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (26,700 affected)
summary: THE BREAST SHIELD COULD SEPARATE FROM THE TONGUE OF THE RESTRAINT ASSEMBLY IN CRASH CONDITIONS BECAUSE OF A FAULTY BUCKLE FRAME.

title: FBS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (17,968 affected)
summary: CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS FAILED TO MEET HEAD EXCURSION REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213 BECAUSE OF CHILD SEAT BASE DESIGN.

title: FBS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (6,495 affected)
summary: CHILD RESTRAINTS HAVE STRIPED SEAT COVERS WHICH FAILED THE FLAMMABILITY REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 213.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HYDROBOOST UNIT (35 affected)
summary: INCORRECT MANUFACTURE OF THE HYDROBOOST CYLINDER ALLOWS THE BALL SOCKET CLAMP TO CONTACT RIGHT SIDE STEERING LEVER ON AN EXTREME LEFT TURN AND CAUSE FLEXING OF THE CYLINDER ROD .

title: HYDRO FLAME CORP.: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE (1,598 affected)
summary: CONTAMINANTS COULD BLOCK THE INTERNAL ORIFICES IN THE ITT VALVES, CAUSING THE GAS CONTROL VALVE TO FAIL IN OPEN POSITION; THIS WOULD ALLOW UNBURNED GAS TO REACH VEHICLE'S LIVING QUARTERS.

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (76,000 affected)
summary: UNDER CERTAIN LOAD CONDITIONS, THE PARK GEAR MAY NOT DISENGAGE IMMEDIATELY WHEN THE TRANSMISSION LEVER IS MOVED FROM PARK TO REVERSE.
